calls.title: Andrew Newdigate and Jeremy Dorn
calls.summary: Andrew Newdigate discussed his near decade-long journey at GitLab, emphasizing his desire to return to a hands-on technical role in a smaller startup environment, influenced by GitLab's organizational changes. He expressed appreciation for open source values and self-managed infrastructure experience. Jeremy Dorn highlighted the company’s need for 3 to 5 full-stack engineers, mainly senior Typescript developers, to facilitate rapid growth. Andrew shared his involvement in substantial projects, including transitioning customers to a Kubernetes-based setup and developing a caching proxy that significantly improved performance. He also addressed GitLab’s AI tooling developments, outlining his usage of AI agents for automation. The discussion included team structures focusing on customer-driven priorities and the technical stack used in projects.
calls.keywords: GitLab, Kubernetes, caching proxy, TypeScript, AI tooling, customer-driven development
